item.title: Bulletin updated at 05:50 HKT 22/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The broad trough of low pressure affecting the coast of southern China will weaken gradually today. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will improve and it will be very hot over the coast of Guangdong in the following couple of days. High temperatures may also trigger showers. The anticyclone aloft is expected to weaken early to midweek next week. There will be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong.
